Name: Clean Shane's Room
Author: pandapants87
Description:
It bugged me that although Shane goes through a lot of growth during his story, the minute you marry him he goes bananas and becomes a huge slob. What happened to drinking soda water, dude?

Anyhoo I modified his room with most of the original elements, but got rid of the gross foot prints that lead to the fridge, the huge keg, and spilled beers. I left some beer cans next to his gaming station because god knows I like to booze it up while I play video games. Anyhoo, I thought I would share in case it was bugging you as well.

**Does not affect other spouses rooms**

Update: Content patcher version by minervamaga. :)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rfrptmF.png[/img]

Installation:
Unzip, and drag to Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps where you have stardew downloaded. :)

Downloads.Description: No tipped beercans, kegs or footprints.
